More than a dinner

The mystery unfolds between courses.

This isn't dinner followed by a murder mystery. The supper is the stage. Every guest receives a character, protects secrets, follows clues and questions suspects as the evening unfolds.

Your character and mystery details arrive privately in your inbox after your seat is confirmed and payment is complete. Royal Indian glamour is encouraged. No acting experience is required.

Founder of 23rd Parallel Supper Club. 23rd Parallel brings Central Indian food, storytelling and intimate community around one table. For this one-night experience, food and mystery become one story.

Before you arrive

Frequently asked questions

Can I come alone?

Yes. Solo guests are welcome. Every guest receives a character and becomes part of the same story.

Do I need acting experience?

No. Your character information guides you. The experience is designed to be playful and social.

Will I know my character beforehand?

Yes. After payment, your character and mystery details are sent privately to your inbox.

Do I have to dress up?

The theme is Royal Indian Glamour — Maharajas, Maharanis and vintage Indian evening style — and guests are encouraged to dress for their role.

Can couples or groups attend?

Yes. Come solo, as a couple or with friends. Everyone participates in the same unfolding mystery.

Is wine included?

Yes. Unlimited wine is included in the $110 experience.

Where is the venue?

The dinner takes place at a private venue in Mountain View, California. The exact address is shared with confirmed guests after payment.
